title: Enhancing antioxidant and bioactive metabolite production in Carthamus tinctorius cell suspension culture through nano-elicitor mediated elicitation
content:

In this study, Se-doped CeO2@Fe3O4 nanoparticles (NPs) were synthesized and applied to a Carthamus tinctorius (safflower) cell suspension culture using liquid medium (B5).
